about.title: About us
about.text1: Quality Pool & Spa brings pools, spas, saunas and wellness products to life on the Costa del Sol and Mallorca, with Swedish West Coast roots.
about.text2: We select products from trusted European suppliers, and we help you from the first idea through planning and delivery to installation.
about.text3: Our aim is simple: quality products, honest advice and a result you will enjoy for many years.
